messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — NebulaCloud sent hero screens for the marketplace onboarding listing. Need a quick pass on logo usage, localized CTAs, and mobile crops. Files: `nebula_hero_1200x628.png`, `nebula_hero_320x180.png`. Drive link: https://rwd/drive/nebula-hero (preview attached). Can design + legal + marketing scan this today?

Alex R.: Reviewing now. First glance: top-left logo violates our 12px clearspace, shadow is crushing type at mobile sizes. Recommend exporting an SVG lockup and a flattened 2x PNG for the marketplace. I can push `nebula_hero_v2.svg` in ~30m.

Priya Shah: Marketing notes — CTA copy needs localization. Proposals: EN: "Get started" / ES: "Comenzar" / FR: "Commencer". Also need two alt-text options: short and detailed. Who's owning alt-text?

Jordan Lee: Legal quick flag: partner approved primary horizontal logo for co-branding (see PDF), but the stacked lockup is not yet signed off. Also request we include the partner trademark notice: "NebulaCloud™" in footer microcopy. I'll attach their terms.

Sam Kim: (nebula PM) nebula-pm-bot: Partner confirmation email attached. They gave provisional OK for the horizontal lockup; stacked lockup requires a sign-off from their brand team. Marketplace tile sizes recommended by cloud marketplace: 1200x628 and 1000x400.

Alex R.: Updated export uploaded: `nebula_hero_v3.png` and `nebula_hero_v3.svg`. Reduced logo scale by 14%, tightened headline line-height, removed the heavy drop-shadow. Quick CSS hint for the web preview: `.hero-logo{image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast;}`

Maya Chen: Thanks Alex. Priya — can you draft localized CTAs + alt-text? Jordan — once you confirm trademark wording, we'll lock copy. Goal: finalize assets for marketplace submission by Friday EOD.

Priya Shah: Will draft alt-text + localized CTAs and post a comment here by 2pm. Short alt: "NebulaCloud partnership hero image". Long alt: "Illustrated cloud network with Redwood Inference and NebulaCloud logos, call-to-action button." Will include translations.

Sam Kim: Update — partner sent the signed approval for the stacked lockup at 16:12 (screenshot attached: `nebula_signed_lockup.png`). They said they prefer the stacked version for mobile tiles.

Jordan Lee: Thanks — received the signed PDF. I've added the trademark line and a one-sentence legal footer. No further blockers from legal.

Maya Chen: Great. I'll assemble final package (SVGS + 2x PNGs + localized CTAs + alt-text + legal microcopy) and submit the marketplace listing request. Adding action items: Alex to export final assets; Priya to post CTAs/alt-text; Jordan to attach legal snippet; Sam to confirm partner contact for marketplace listing questions.

nebula-pm-bot: Drive folder updated with final assets: https://rwd/drive/nebula-hero/final (timestamp 2332100360).

Maya Chen: Perfect — shipping this afternoon. :rocket: If anyone sees anything else, flag here and I'll hold the submission.
